payload.description: Create reviewable venture-scoped candidate and evidence only from a current observed-content atom whose text contains the exact question. Never queue or publish.

field_docs.work_selector: which topics/keywords/items to produce next (a DATA content-topic-set)
field_docs.context_retrieval: corpus + retrieval descriptor (dispatched to knowledge-records/meaning-search) or provided grounding
field_docs.instruction_plan: {prompt_template:[segments]} rendered by compose-run-request.py; segments reference ai-instruction-blocks + slots
field_docs.output_contract: {schema} the output shape the model must return (DATA)
field_docs.delivery_target: {definition_id,input,summary_from?,body_render?} where accepted output is delivered; definition_id is the caller-declared destination owner action and input maps only item/work_item/context/derived values
field_docs.gate_policy: {grounded,min_excerpts,cite_or_reject,grounding_id_field,citation_specs,checks:[{kind,params}]} fail-closed gates; DATA can require per-element supplied-only grounding and trusted-labelled normalized forbidden prose fragments before owner delivery

payload.note: One run-ledger record per (recipe, work item) run: state cursor + outcome. Engine truth.

Durable create-only cross-slot handoff. Lifecycle is derived from this immutable pending request plus the correlated terminal trigger-dispatch-outcome fact; bounded retries are trigger-rule DATA, so no second mutable lifecycle owner exists. Trigger delivery is decoupled from the originating Workflow acknowledgement, eliminating the circular wait without claiming a false happens-after ordering.

payload.name: run content generation
payload.description: Blind recipe interpreter: resolve instruction blocks -> compose instruction from recipe DATA -> dispatch ai-records-producer -> gate (fail-closed) -> deliver accepted output to the caller-declared owner action. Owns no domain, no prompt, no model call, and never writes another owner's body.

extra.isolation: names only Envelope addresses; holds no prompt/model/domain; all product config is content-generation.recipe DATA

payload.name: dispatch durable content-generation request
payload.description: Submit the selected work without blocking other triggers. Submission means queued, not finished; the later execution outcome and saved result must be checked separately.

payload.name: drain next content work item
payload.description: Pop the next pending work item from the recipe's work-item queue and atomically create its deterministic owner-action request. The request address has a create-only expected-current claim, so concurrent pumps converge on one record and the losing batch changes nothing. Trigger delivery is decoupled from the pump acknowledgement, removing the Workflow->process->Workflow circular wait. Queue kind, status field, run definition id, and recipe ref are DATA. Owns no domain or destination-body identity.

payload.name: Review audience question
payload.description: Review one current venture-scoped audience question against current evidence, known answers and pending work. Create an accepted or rejected decision and verify readback; never publish content.

payload.name: admit reviewed audience question
payload.description: Read a current candidate, accepted review and source evidence, reject duplicates, create one pending venture-scoped work item, and verify readback. Does not generate or publish content.

payload.name: reconcile dispatch requests
payload.description: Re-dispatch at most one caller-selected request record lacking a correlated completion record. Request kind, completion kind, correlation fields, app URL, partition, and timeout are input DATA.

payload.name: Link answer evidence
payload.description: Link one independently cleared current answer source to a venture question using the current candidate basis, then verify readback. Does not clear rights, review, or publish.
